messages:
Anya (CS): Heads-up - SolaceTech private VPC: audit logs stopped delivering after their CMK rotation. Renewal touchpoint Friday; customer wants proof before the meeting.

Omar (Infra): Can you paste the forwarder error and bucket ARN so we can triage?

Anya (CS): Forwarder log 2026-03-18T20:05Z:
```ERROR PutObject 403 AccessDenied; caused by KMS:Encrypt failed for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:333444555666:key/fb2a1c9e```
Bucket: solace-logs-prod (acct 333444555666)

Priya (Ops): Likely missing kms:Encrypt permission on the new key and key policy blocking our role arn:arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/rdw-forwarder-prod. Also their bucket policy denies external puts.

Leo (SolaceTech): We rotated the key last night and temporarily disabled the old key. Happy to allow a temp grant if you document the steps.

Omar (Infra): I'll open a small key-policy PR and generate a one-off grant. Proposed snippet: allow rdw-forwarder-prod kms:Encrypt, GenerateDataKey on that key.

Priya (Ops): Applying grant now: `aws kms create-grant --key-id fb2a1c9e --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/rdw-forwarder-prod --operations Encrypt GenerateDataKey`

deploy-bot: pipeline/rdw-forwarder-prod build 1013 started
deploy-bot: pipeline/rdw-forwarder-prod build 1013 passed

Priya (Ops): Rolled change, restarted forwarder. Watching logs.

Anya (CS): Scheduling a 30-min enablement for Leo + infra tomorrow 09:00 PT to walk rotation play and capture evidence. Also creating CS-7782 to track docs + S3/CloudTrail proof. Marking renewal-risk=medium until evidence attached.

Priya (Ops): Forwarder logs show PutObject 200 and KMS GenerateDataKey OK :tada:

Omar (Infra): Merged key policy PR and added runbook paragraph on pre-granting during rotation.

Leo (SolaceTech): I posted CloudTrail events and S3 access log screenshot showing PutObject from your principal. Thanks for the quick fix.

Anya (CS): Attached evidence to CS-7782, recorded enablement, added 1-page rotation howto. Updating renewal-risk=low. Closing loop from our side.

Leo (SolaceTech): All good here. Appreciate the fast response.
